Register to Attend
Getting Started:
New Users
:
1)
Create
a conference account.
2) Follow the registration instructions below.
Existing Users
:
1) Log in to your existing account (upper right-hand corner of this page).
Note: Your TAICEP Spring Webinar Series account is separate from your TAICEP membership account, so your TAICEP website login credentials will not work on the Spring Webinar Series website.
2) Follow the registration instructions below.
Register:
1) At the bottom of this page, first select the number of attendees you are registering. Choose "1" if you are registering only yourself.
2) When registering each individual, fill in the required information and choose the ticket options from the list on the right.
3) During checkout, you will have the option to pay either by credit card or check.
If you experience difficulty submitting payment through PayPal's 'Pay with Credit/Debit Card' option, you can often resolve the issue by contacting your credit card company or bank, which may have flagged the transaction as suspicious. You can also try using a different internet browser and/or clearing your browser cache and cookies.
If you have questions about the registration process, please email
answers@taicep.org
.
TAICEP Member Discount
The TAICEP Member price is available only to individuals whose membership is current at the time of registration. Members enjoy many benefits, including an immediate discount on your webinar series registration. If you are unsure about the status of your membership, please inquire to
answers@taicep.org
. Registration fees do not include TAICEP membership dues.
Webinar Series
Check-in
Your Spring Webinar registration includes all webinars in the series. The series is offered in a package only. Check-in to each session is available 15 minutes prior to the session. You must login to your Dryfta account, access your Spring Webinar Series session, and the Zoom link to sign-on to the session should be available 15 minutes prior to the start of the session.
Help a Colleague Donation:
Did you enjoy your past TAICEP webinar experiences and want to pay it forward? Even the smallest donation can make a huge difference. Starting at only $250, you can provide professional development opportunities to your colleagues who receive little-to-no financial support. Below you will see the option to purchase additional tickets to help a deserving colleague attend this year's webinar series.
Refunds:
Please carefully review the TAICEP Cancellation Terms at the bottom of the
homepage
.

REFUND POLICY TERMS AND CONDITIONS
TAICEP Webinar Series | Cancellation Terms
TAICEP reserves the right to alter or cancel, without prior notice, any of the arrangements relating directly or indirectly to its webinar series for any circumstances beyond TAICEP's reasonable control. TAICEP will not accept liability for any losses and/or damages registered participants may suffer on account of any alteration or cancellation.
Registered participants may receive a refund of webinar series registration costs paid to TAICEP, minus the following cancellation fees:
A. $50 fee if the webinar series attendee cancels 1-7 days before the webinar. This fee helps offset TAICEP's per attendee administrative costs.
B. No refunds will be made if the webinar series attendee cancels on or after the first day of the webinar.
Attendee substitutions are permitted without penalty but must be done in advance of the webinar series and requests should be sent via
Email
.
Photo and Video Release
By attending the TAICEP Webinar Series, you consent to photography, audio recording, video recording, interviews and its/their release, publication, exhibition, or reproduction to be used for news, promotional purposes, advertising, inclusion on websites, or any other purpose by TAICEP. You release TAICEP and each and all persons involved from any liability connected with the taking, recording, digitizing, or publication of interviews, photographs, computer images, video and/or sound recordings.
